topics.title: Howard Stern and Celeste's Persistent Requests
topics.summary: During a phone interview, Howard Stern recounts his interactions with an obsessive fan named Celeste who repeatedly requests free admission to events and demands service from him via postcards and calls; he attempts to ignore her persistent requests while she continues to demand seating privileges.

topics.title: Radio Broadcast: Tourism, Comedy & Tabloid
topics.summary: Governor Jim Clore promotes New Jersey tourism via a radio broadcast, followed by a segment featuring the comedy show 'The Marshall Chronicles' and coverage of a tabloid story about comedian Sam Kinnesson dating Lenny Bruce’s mother. The program concludes with discussions regarding car dealership promotions and an unusual phone call.

topics.title: May-December Romance & Multiple Relationships
topics.summary: Sally Mark (83) discusses her unusual romance with Sam, who gifted her $100,000, preferring older men due to their relaxed nature. A surprising revelation emerges: she’s also dating Lenny Bruce's daughter, Rosemary, creating a complex web of relationships involving multiple partners and sparking humorous discussions about age differences and potential sexual activity.

topics.title: Conflicting Calls and Alzheimer’s Concerns
topics.summary: A caller discusses his son’s unusual behavior involving female dogs and a marriage with three children, while reports emerge about Frank Presley committing himself to an institution. Simultaneously, concerns arise regarding the financial burden of Alzheimer's disease and potential dietary causes, alongside discussions about comic relief performances by established comedians.

topics.title: Casino Win, Sextuplets & License Issues
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss a casino patron’s large slot machine win alongside the birth of six sextulets. They also touch upon Donald Trump's charitable organization facing scrutiny and an individual experiencing issues with their insurance policy due to prior driving offenses; no specific details are provided.

topics.title: Radio Segment Featuring Disjointed Conversations
topics.summary: A radio segment features a series of fragmented conversations, including discussions about Grammy nominations for comedic music with PD Q Bach and observations regarding film crew performance alongside opinions on mental health evaluations and skinheads. The segment concludes with advertising announcements.
